classification.difficultyReason: Select straight-line and vertically opposite angle relationships to form equations; in part b, solve for x and use the resulting angles to determine y and z.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals in the following geometric diagrams.

spec.description: Two straight lines form a broad X. Upper and lower vertically opposite angles have arcs and algebraic labels.
spec.answerVisibility: Angle expressions are permanent givens; the supplied value of x is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}
6x-5 &= 4x+35\\
2x-5 &= 35\\
2x &= 40\\
x &= 20
\end{align*}$$
Both labelled angles are $115^\circ$.

spec.description: A nearly vertical straight line leaning right towards its upper endpoint crosses a diagonal rising from lower left to upper right. Four angle arcs associate the labels with their sectors.
spec.mathematics: Upper-right acute angle (2z + 7)°; lower-left acute angle (x + 10)°; upper-left obtuse angle (9x)°; lower-right obtuse angle (3y)°. Opposite angles are equal and adjacent angles sum to 180°.
spec.answerVisibility: All four algebraic angle labels are permanent givens; supplied pronumeral values are excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Adjacent angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
9x+(x+10) &= 180\\
10x+10 &= 180\\
10x &= 170\\
x &= 17
\end{align*}$$
Vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}
3y &= 9(17)\\
3y &= 153\\
y &= 51
\end{align*}$$
The other pair of vertically opposite angles is equal.
$$\begin{align*}
2z+7 &= 17+10\\
2z+7 &= 27\\
2z &= 20\\
z &= 10
\end{align*}$$
The angles are $27^\circ$ and $153^\circ$, which sum to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Two straight lines form a narrow upright X. Left and right vertically opposite angles have arcs and algebraic labels.
spec.answerVisibility: Angle expressions are permanent givens; the supplied fractional value of x is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}
100-2x &= 26x+2\\
100 &= 28x+2\\
98 &= 28x\\
x &= \frac{7}{2}
\end{align*}$$
Both labelled angles are $93^\circ$.
